# Frozen legacy generator outputs

`synthetic-v1.npz` contains all feature and target arrays generated by
`src/felt/data.py` at commit `b6e1151b3247a858d9467bbf5201fec96c7aad76`, before
the sound-diversity changes, using `configs/experiment001.json`. The accompanying
JSON preserves split, family, pattern, seed, tempo and beat metadata.

These original synthetic outputs are MIT-licensed with the repository. They were
captured on macOS ARM64 with the repository's locked Python environment. The
regression test requires exact metadata and numeric agreement within relative
1e-5 and absolute 1e-7 tolerances for floating-point features and targets. Tests
also independently require exact regeneration within the current environment.

A raw byte hash is not a portable numeric equivalence test across operating
systems. Training/resume and default evaluation keep their strict dataset identity
checks. Do not regenerate these fixtures automatically when a test fails.
